analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and file metadata against the indexed threat model; only selected definitions had full detail. No concrete security regression is established locally. ModelLoadAdmission.swift:45-50 changes documentation only; its OS clamp, saturating arithmetic and outstanding-commitment subtraction remain. SystemMemory.swift:60-86 expands default admission credit to file-backed/purgeable pages while subtracting speculative overlap; free-only and sampling-failure behavior remain unchanged. Integration should validate Mach counter disjointness/reclaimability and interaction with ModelLoadAdmission.swift:110's addition of MLX usage, avoiding duplicate reclaim credit for file-backed MLX allocations.
GLM5NextManagedLoad.swift:155-182 adds phase timing, post-construction cache dropping and publication of the manifest aggregate. Existing permit checks, auxiliary verification, identity rechecks, GPU fence and fail-closed retirement remain visible. Logs contain model identity/count/timing, not prompts or credentials. For A-004/T-012/T-027 and T-041's verified-weight cache binding, integration must verify native core-file hashing, auxiliary coverage, snapshot rechecks, aggregate equivalence with WeightHasher, and consumers of verifiedArtifactSHA256. These are external contracts, not proven missing controls. Review PageCache.drop's implementation, particularly pathname handling after ownership release at :172.
DeadlineRuntimeEnvironment.swift:16 newly allows DARKBLOOM_VERIFIED_WEIGHTS_FILE without rejecting deadline qualification. Its reader/writer must establish that this selects operational state only, not untrusted verification or performance overrides (T-055/T-056). FlintResponseFormat.swift's supplied patch removes the explicit-type check at base :36 and helper at :46-64; shared compilation remains. This permits previously rejected schemas and may narrow untyped outputs, but no authorization bypass or resource-bound removal is shown. Full Flint source is absent. No visible changes affect encryption, tokens, Apple serving grants, billing or privileged fan authority. Remaining cross-file contracts require integration review.
